criteria.time_basis: Existing fixed 10 Hz simulation-time evaluation grid; crossings are sampled brackets, not interpolated physical event times

metrics.definition: Absolute opposite-side crossing relative to initial error sign; no percent step normalization. Settling is the start of the final active, in-band, continuously evidenced suffix lasting >=3 s through the interval end. Missing truth, inactive control and gaps interrupt the suffix; null settling is right-censored, never zero.
